title: Romeo
html_source:
Romeo and Juliet Act 4-5
Romeo receives news of Juliet’s supposed death. Desperate, Romeo buys poison from an apothecary and returns to Verona. Late that night, Romeo enters the Capulet tomb, but is confronted by Paris, whom he fights and kills.
Still unaware that Juliet is in fact alive, Romeo takes the poison and dies.
